high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "Jagga Jasoos," directed by Vasan Bala and produced by Karan Johar, Apoorva Mehta, Alia Bhatt, Shaheen Bhatt, and Somen Mishra. The poster prominently features the title "JAGGA JASOOS" in large, stylized white letters on the left side. The central figure in the poster is a young woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a loose, striped shirt and black pants. She has a serious expression and is looking over her shoulder towards the viewer. Her pose suggests confidence or defiance
